text_block_list.text: One day, when I came out to do some shopping……

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, which one, which one!?
Which should I pick~?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Seasonal special! Wanna try the brand-new
'Addictively Stimulating Chips' flavor~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Or should we go with Maya's classic go-to,
the 'Berry Super-Sweet Choco'?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, I can't choose~.
Which after-school snack should I get today~?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, you over there!
Which one do you think is better?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! You gotta have a little kick♪
I'm not great with spicy food, but I'm gonna go for it!

One's philosophy on snacks
might just apply to running as well.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I see~ When it comes to snacks, reliable
stability really is king after all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It'd be such a bummer if I picked the wrong one!
Alrighty, this is the one I choose!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm-hmm~♪ Is school almost out yet~?♪

One's philosophy on snacks
might just apply to running as well.
